captured_costs.interpretation: Single run, descriptive only; no effectiveness/cost gate or production extrapolation. Operation runtime and durability are separate, never added twice.

captured_publication_costs.note: Measured once. Excludes final integrity publication and subsequent read-only verification.

B_wrapper_with_capture_profiler.note: Q1 exact observed_ppr callback covers entire rank wrapper, not just kernel. No journal or scientific schedule.

B_wrapper_without_profiler.note: Q1 frozen wrapper includes view/lexical validation, state construction and incoming diagnostics; engineering repetition only.

canonical_filename_index_rebuild.note: Query-independent construction currently repeated inside canonical BM25 API; actual online BM25 samples include it.

frame_adaptation.note: Native retained-frame reconstruction includes temporary filesystem observation and frame identity checks; no journal/publication.

full_ri_derivation.note: Sum of individually timed canonical per-resource derivations. Progress, equality checks, loop bookkeeping and publication excluded. No extra full warmup because three full passes are already expensive.

lexical_index.note: Statistics and inverted index only; excludes experiment fingerprint.

native_graph_build_with_checks.note: Current experiment wrapper: endpoint/provenance identities and pair construction; separately compare pure graph computation.

one_resource_ri.note: Existing per-resource primitive; candidate, not a complete invalidation system. Representative full-pass median source: tests/observability/evidence/test_terminal.py

memory.limitations: tracemalloc incremental Python allocations; existing frame/graph/index excluded from warm peaks. Native-return decode includes all retained returns, a conservative upper bound for RI alone. No process RSS, allocator arenas, OS cache or external allocations measured. Memory runs are excluded from latency samples.
